arms.B: 64 independent replacement trajectories under fresh appearances
arms.C: the 64 source trajectories under appearances unique within the block
arms.D: one independent neighbor per source, closer than anything in base training: RMS state distance in [0.25, 0.5] x the source's nearest base-training distance
arms.D2: one reservoir-selected independent neighbor per source in the 0.1st-1st percentile band of pairwise independent distances (comparable to base-training nearest neighbors)
arms.E: the exact renders forming the exact population (diagnostic reference, not a ceiling)

config.base_competence_screen: Pre-treatment screen on a separate 256-event competence population (never scored in contrasts): a block enters the primary analysis iff its base model's bounded error there is below constant velocity's. All blocks reported; intent-to-treat over all completed blocks is a sensitivity analysis.
config.claim_boundary: Discarded. No effect estimate from this run may be inspected or reported.

closer_nearby.construction: box-conditioned band distribution: uniform initial-state prior restricted to a sensitivity-scaled box (edge offset alone gives 6x the band maximum; capped at the full parameter range) and conditioned on RMS state distance in [0.25, 0.5] x the source's nearest base-training distance
closer_nearby.containment_validation: results/closer_sampler_validation.json (box enlargement 6 vs 9, reservoir agreement, capped fractions); empirical, not a proof

config.exposure_dose: 800 arm-slot presentations over 64 sources per arm: 12 or 13 presentations per source
config.failure_policy: Infrastructure errors (OSError, MemoryError, device/MPS runtime errors) retry once with identical seeds; other exceptions are algorithmic failures. All failures are recorded.
config.name: exposure_pilot_v5

nearby.construction: independently simulated reservoir events assigned one-to-one by maximum bipartite matching inside a state-distance quantile band

populations.exact: the render E trains on; unseen by B, C, and D
populations.independent: 512 independently sampled trajectories under fresh appearances
populations.source: 4 held-out renders per source trajectory, unseen by every arm

config.positive_control: E exact-population gain over B positive in at least 75% of scheduled blocks
config.primary_metric: mean over examples of per-disk-frame Euclidean center error, capped at 1 arena width; nonfinite outputs receive the cap
config.purpose: Estimate contrast dispersion, runtime, and assay sensitivity under the exact confirmatory protocol without releasing effect locations.
config.seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence(entropy=experiment_seed, spawn_key=(block_index,)) spawned into data, schedule, base_batches, torch roles
config.supersedes: v4 capped box half-widths at half the parameter range, which excluded valid band members (round-2 counterexample); v4 also screened competence on the scored independent population.
